# Waits until Monday, September 28, 2026 at 10:00 AM, then fires the reminder.

TARGET="2026-09-28 10:00:00"

echo "⏳ Reminder scheduled for $TARGET"

while true; do
    NOW_EPOCH=$(date +%s)
    if [ "$NOW_EPOCH" -ge "$TARGET_EPOCH" ]; then
        /workspace/address_update_reminder.sh
        echo "✅ Reminder fired at $(date)"
        break
    fi
    sleep 60
done
